pick.headline: Raul Alfonsin inaugurated, ending military rule in Argentina
pick.summary: On December 10, 1983, Raul Alfonsin was sworn in as president of Argentina, ending seven years of military rule.
pick.significance: He soon decreed the prosecution of the junta leaders for the disappearances.

alternates.headline: Czechoslovakia gets a non-communist government; Husak resigns
alternates.summary: On December 10, 1989, President Gustav Husak swore in a government with a non-communist majority, then resigned.
alternates.significance: Husak had presided over the 'normalisation' after the 1968 invasion; his departure cleared the way for Havel's election.
